label: H.R. 4638
title: Federal Working Animal Protection Act

items.snippet: This bill establishes that a non-U.S. national ( alien under federal law) convicted of, or who admits to having committed, an offense related to harming animals used in law enforcement is inadmissible and deportable.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
